"""Finish on a bag's page: a new bag record with finished_on (never a delete). The bag leaves Today, Switch coffee
and Log shot, and stays in Coffees."""

from datetime import date, timedelta

import pyarrow.parquet as pq

from .test_app import W, client, files, prefill, shot  # noqa: F401 - client is a fixture

DAY = "2026-10-30"


def finish(c, bag_id="bag1", headers=W, **body):
    return c.post(f"/api/bags/{bag_id}/finish", json=body or {"finished_on": DAY}, headers=headers)


def test_the_bag_page_offers_finish_until_the_bag_is_finished(client):  # noqa: F811
    page = client.get("/coffee/bag1").text
    assert 'data-finish="bag1"' in page and "Finish bag" in page
    assert finish(client).status_code == 200
    page = client.get("/coffee/bag1").text
    assert "data-finish=" not in page and "finished Oct 30" in page


def test_finishing_writes_a_new_record_and_deletes_nothing(client, lake):  # noqa: F811
    before = files(lake, "bags")
    r = finish(client)
    assert r.json() == {"bag_id": "bag1", "written": True}
    after = files(lake, "bags")
    assert set(before) < set(after) and len(after) == len(before) + 1  # every earlier file is still there
    rows = sorted((pq.read_table(p).to_pylist()[0] for p in after), key=lambda x: x["logged_at"])
    assert rows[-1]["finished_on"] == date(2026, 10, 30) and rows[-1]["deleted"] is False
    # The rest of the bag is the stored one, not something the phone sent.
    assert rows[-1]["coffee_freetext"] == "Onyx Geometry" and rows[-1]["roast_date"] == date(2026, 10, 18)


def test_finishing_twice_writes_once_and_keeps_the_first_day(client, lake):  # noqa: F811
    finish(client)
    n = len(files(lake, "bags"))
    r = finish(client, finished_on="2026-10-31")  # the outbox resends, or a second phone
    assert r.status_code == 200 and r.json()["written"] is False
    assert len(files(lake, "bags")) == n
    assert client.app.state.store.bag("owner", "bag1").finished_on == date(2026, 10, 30)


def test_finished_bag_leaves_today_and_the_pickers_but_stays_in_coffees(client):  # noqa: F811
    client.post("/api/shots", json=shot(1), headers=W)
    client.post("/api/bags", json={"bag_id": "bag2", "coffee_freetext": "Other coffee"}, headers=W)
    client.post("/api/shots", json=shot(2, bag_id="bag2"), headers=W)
    client.get("/bag/bag1/use")  # bag1 selected on this phone
    assert "Onyx Geometry" in client.get("/").text and "Switch coffee" in client.get("/").text

    finish(client)
    today = client.get("/").text
    assert "Onyx Geometry" not in today and "Other coffee" in today
    assert "Switch coffee" not in today  # one open bag left: nothing to switch between
    assert "Onyx Geometry" not in client.get("/bags/switch").text
    assert prefill(client)["bag_id"] == "bag2"  # the selected bag is finished: Log shot moves on
    assert client.get("/bag/bag1/use").status_code == 404
    log = client.get("/log").text
    assert "Onyx Geometry" not in log

    coffees = client.get("/coffees").text
    assert "Onyx Geometry" in coffees and "· finished" in coffees and "Other coffee" in coffees
    assert client.get("/coffee/bag1").status_code == 200
    assert client.get("/shot/s1").status_code == 200  # its shots are kept
    assert "Onyx Geometry" in client.get("/history").text

    """Before Finish: with no open bag, Today and Log shot fell back to the last shot's coffee, so the finished
    bag came back as "Last coffee" and the next shot was logged against it without a bag."""
    client.post("/api/shots", json=shot(1), headers=W)

    today = client.get("/").text
    assert "Nothing on the grinder" in today and "Onyx Geometry" not in today

    # A shot of the finished bag can still be corrected from its page.
    fix = client.get("/log?correct=s1")
    assert fix.status_code == 200 and "Onyx Geometry" in fix.text


def test_loose_shots_from_before_bags_still_stand_in_with_no_open_bag(client):  # noqa: F811
    finish(client)
    client.post("/api/shots", json=shot(1, bag_id=None, coffee_freetext="Old house blend"), headers=W)
    assert "Old house blend" in client.get("/").text


def test_finish_is_scoped_dated_and_checked(client, lake):  # noqa: F811
    maya = W | {"x-test-user": "maya", "X-Expected-User": "maya"}
    n = len(files(lake, "bags"))
    assert finish(client, headers=maya).status_code == 404  # someone else's bag looks missing

    assert client.post("/api/bags", json=record, headers=W).status_code == 200
    assert "Onyx Geometry" in client.get("/").text and 'data-finish="bag1"' in client.get("/coffee/bag1").text

    return c.post(f"/api/bags/{bag_id}/finish", json=body or {"finished_on": DAY}, headers=headers)

    page = client.get("/coffee/bag1").text
    assert 'data-finish="bag1"' in page and "Finish bag" in page
    assert finish(client).status_code == 200
    page = client.get("/coffee/bag1").text
    assert "data-finish=" not in page and "finished Oct 30" in page


def test_finishing_writes_a_new_record_and_deletes_nothing(client, lake):  # noqa: F811
    before = files(lake, "bags")
    r = finish(client)
    assert r.json() == {"bag_id": "bag1", "written": True}
    after = files(lake, "bags")
    assert set(before) < set(after) and len(after) == len(before) + 1  # every earlier file is still there
    rows = sorted((pq.read_table(p).to_pylist()[0] for p in after), key=lambda x: x["logged_at"])
    assert rows[-1]["finished_on"] == date(2026, 10, 30) and rows[-1]["deleted"] is False
    # The rest of the bag is the stored one, not something the phone sent.
    assert rows[-1]["coffee_freetext"] == "Onyx Geometry" and rows[-1]["roast_date"] == date(2026, 10, 18)


def test_finishing_twice_writes_once_and_keeps_the_first_day(client, lake):  # noqa: F811

    n = len(files(lake, "bags"))

    assert r.status_code == 200 and r.json()["written"] is False
    assert len(files(lake, "bags")) == n
